purpose: Teach: 有利/他者/ロンドン/清水/余りに/不便/スケール/優位

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、テストの結果、絶対、有利、絶対、だったよ
lines.en: Mom, really, I did so well on my test!
lines.style: Eager, bouncing slightly on the words. Quick delivery with bright emphasis on the good news. No pause before sharing — this is important and he wants her to know it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、他者、絶対、への、絶対、思いやり、絶対、忘れないでね
lines.en: Sho, sweetheart, that's wonderful — but remember to think about how the other kids might feel too, okay?
lines.style: Warm, gentle but clear. A soft touch on the redirection. Not lecturing — maternal wisdom delivered as a quiet reminder, eyes still kind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、ロンドン、絶対、出張、絶対、行くんだよね?本気で
lines.en: Mom, is Dad really going to London for that work trip?
lines.style: Small, genuine question. He's turning the attention outward suddenly — checking something that's been on his mind. Voice quiets slightly, almost testing to see if it's okay to ask.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度、本気で、絶対、家族で、絶対、清水、絶対、寺、絶対、行きましょう、翔くん
lines.en: Next time, let's go to Kiyomizu Temple together as a family, okay Sho?
lines.style: Warm redirect with intention. She's heard the worry underneath his question. Said with quiet purpose — an offer, not dismissing what he asked, but opening a door instead.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、余りに、絶対、お野菜が、絶対、多くて、絶対、食べきれないよ
lines.en: Mom, there's so much vegetable on my plate — I can't eat it all!
lines.style: Small, real complaint with the tiniest edge of humor. Not whining — stating a genuine problem with a kid's dry observation. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、宿題、絶対、不便、絶対、な、絶対、ところが、絶対、あったら、絶対、教えてね
lines.en: Sho, if there's anything about your homework that's confusing or hard, you'll tell me, right?
lines.style: Checking in with genuine openness. Not hovering — creating space for him to say if he's struggling. Warm but direct, the way you ask someone you trust to trust you back.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、絵の、絶対、スケール、絶対、大きくしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I made my painting much bigger this time!
lines.style: Pride in the accomplishment — a small achievement he's worked at. Voice lifts slightly on 'bigger.' He's showing her something he did, not just telling her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、運動会で、絶対、優位、絶対、に、絶対、立てたんでしょ
lines.en: Sho, you really stood out at the sports day, didn't you?
lines.style: Genuinely delighted recognition. Warm close-in on the praise — she sees what he did, and she's letting him know. Not over-the-top, just real maternal pride.
